name: rust-module-discovery
body: The Rust frontend must discover every Cargo project under the scan root — not just the one manifest it finds from the root — so nested non-workspace crates (the src/rustlib gap) produce their module and symbols. Root cause (verified): src/rustlib is a separate Cargo project (its own Cargo.toml naming apg-rustfrontend, its own Cargo.lock, isolated src/rustlib/target/, edition = "2021", and ra_ap_* deps pinned to a rust-analyzer git tag), and the frontend calls ProjectManifest::discover_single (src/rustlib/src/main.rs:513), so from the repo root it loads only the root apg package and src/rustlib yields no module and no symbols. Decomposes into all-manifest discovery, workspace dedup, generated-tree exclusion, preserving build isolation, clean nested FQNs, and the fixture acceptance. Feature rust-module-discovery.
